# Recorded 2026-08-05 during the Phase 0 vocabulary pass.
# WHY THIS SECTION EXISTS: vocab.py harvests single words, so every multiword
# descriptor is destroyed at harvest time. "lily of the valley" becomes a stray
# `valley` (353 occ) with `lily` (190) orphaned elsewhere. An n-gram heuristic was
# tried and produced worse output than the unigram version — "used to produce" and
# "for instance to impart" outranked real terms — so multiword forms are recorded
# BY HAND here instead. That is what this table is for: the one place a human, not
# a model, decides what a span means.
# COUNTS ARE FROM THE CORPUS, not from memory. Every form below was verified to
# occur in corpus/extracted/candidates.json before being written down. Familiar
# phrases that do not occur are not listed, however obvious they seem.
# TAGS ARE DELIBERATELY BLANK. The tag vocabulary does not exist yet — it is the
# output of the D/H/T/M/X pass now in progress. Filling this column before the tag
# list is settled would be building the ontology from the wrong end.
